scenarios.theme: A worker retries one captured-order event and doubles revenue. What boundary will you use?
scenarios.assumptions: A dashboard consumes order-captured events with at-least-once delivery. A crash can occur after changing the total but before acknowledging the message. Each captured order must contribute once. What will you do?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.
